main_text.p: [illegible, ~20 letters] gne reliffi ... [illegible, ~30 letters] tes, Conjules exercitus contra[?] predtigarent, & recepta ab Equit Comitiis, eandem exercere. Tribuni, ut quanto bellum a tribunis [?] decem Tribuni annui fierent, [illegible, ~40 letters] ftratibus suæ potestatis violatores, redilert s[?] erent; Decemviri legibus scribendis perfectis, imperitabant. Decemviri, principes sine provocatione facti, initis duodecim tabulis legibus, potestate ad Tyrannidem, quam precipue Appius Claudius in Sociorum Decemvirum, [illegible, ~25 letters] tuta, sed fors pulchrè eximia, & Virginem filiam Virginiam, (hanc ut ponerent, Cliuitium ruborem vi qui puellam ex ancilla sua natam confirmando, amatore judice, in servitutem abstraheret) exercere volebat, abusi, condolerent Magistratum reducendi, ut ut subinde Tribuni multum [?] potestate armaretur, occasionem de- [?] tere. Consules reduxit, ut Romanus populum [?] que obligaret, quod plebs tribunus tacere[?] & negaret Magistratus sine provocationis lege[?] ut, detinebat. Plebs, ut patriciorum & plebis sanguine (?) tiuerent, & Tribuni militares ex utrisque iterum ... Sopus ... regnum per largitiones affectans, à Cincinnato oppressus est. Fulvius bellum moverat, nec sanae prior iplorum exfictidi potestatem, quam Consules agerent. Ibidem Sylvanus Ludem a Thucidide quendam sub nomine Tiburnii (quo nam) legibus Ciuitatem ... [illegible, ~20 letters] ut Chamada) restaurandi Brutus ... [illegible, ~15 letters] ... Tumultum ...

page.notes: Heavily damaged and faded page; many words illegible or doubtful. Marginal reference numbers in left margin (e.g. 3.3 etc.) partly unreadable. Transcription of the Latin is approximate; the text is from Tacitus, Annales Lib. II (ch. 27–28 region) and should be checked against the scan.
